questions.question: Which pronoun replaces "Maria"?
questions.explanation: Maria is a girl, so we use the pronoun "she".

questions.question: Fill in: "Can you help ___?" (referring to yourself)
questions.explanation: When you receive an action, use the object pronoun "me".

questions.question: Which is the object pronoun for "he"?
questions.explanation: "Him" is the object pronoun for "he". Example: I saw him.

questions.question: Replace the children: "The children are playing."
questions.explanation: "The children" is replaced by the subject pronoun "they".

questions.question: Vel rett: "Anna is my friend. I like ___."
questions.explanation: When Anna receives the action (being liked), we use the object pronoun "her".
